definitions.explanation: The act of depositing money into a bank account or entrusting luggage or belongings to a storage service. Common in banking and travel contexts.

examples.japanese: ATMで{預|あず}け{入|い}れをする。
examples.english: I make a deposit at the ATM.

examples.japanese: {手荷物|てにもつ}の{預|あず}け{入|い}れはカウンターで{行|おこな}います。
examples.english: Luggage check-in is done at the counter.

examples.japanese: {定期|ていき}{預金|よきん}の{預|あず}け{入|い}れ{手続|てつづ}きに{必要|ひつよう}な{書類|しょるい}を{持|も}って{銀行|ぎんこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the bank with the documents needed for the fixed deposit procedure.

notes:
USAGE: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ is the noun form of {預|あず}け{入|い}れる (to deposit). It is used in both financial contexts (depositing money) and travel contexts (checking in luggage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れをする: to make a deposit
- {現金|げんきん}の{預|あず}け{入|い}れ: cash deposit
- {手荷物|てにもつ}の{預|あず}け{入|い}れ: luggage check-in
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{限度額|げんどがく}: deposit limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ: depositing (putting money/items in)
- {引|ひ}き{出|だ}し: withdrawal (taking money/items out)
